**Describe the results you received:**

**Describe the results you expected:**

anyway, i have improved the bgp_route module to leverage the frr json output directly instead of comand line output parse. it should improve the robustness of the test.

https://github.com/Azure/sonic-mgmt/pull/2406

linkedPullRequests.title: [ansible]: parse json output for frr in bgp_route module
linkedPullRequests.author: lguohan
linkedPullRequests.body:
frr support json output, it is more robust to use frr json
output directly instead of parsing the cmd line

Resolves https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/issues/5556

Signed-off-by: Guohan Lu <lguohan@gmail.com>

output directly instead of parsing the cmd line

#### How did you do it?
